title: POLARIS: Guiding Small Models to Write Long Stories
abstract: arXiv:2606.04095v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Small open-weight models struggle at long-form creative writing: their generated stories either fall far short of the requested length, or their quality significantly degrades as length increases, especially when compared to frontier models. We present POLARIS (Policy Optimization with LLM-as-a-judge rewards and Anchored-Reference Injection for Storywriting), a lower-compute GRPO recipe with two key ingredients: a frontier LLM judge with a structured Story Quality rubric as the online reward, and human-reference injection (HRI), where a teacher-forced human-written story serves as a high-reward anchor within each GRPO group. By applying our training recipe to Qwen3.5-9B, using a dataset of approximately 1.4K prompt-story pairs derived from 100 short-story anthologies and 4 A100 GPUs, we obtain POLARIS-9B. translated_title: POLARIS：引导小型模型创作长篇故事
translated_abstract: 小型开源权重模型在长篇创意写作方面表现不佳：它们生成的故事要么远达不到所要求的长度，要么随着长度增加质量显著下降，与前沿模型相比尤其如此。我们提出了POLARIS（基于LLM评判奖励与锚定参考注入的故事写作策略优化），这是一种低计算量的GRPO训练方案，包含两个关键要素：一是以带有结构化“故事质量”评分标准的前沿LLM评判者作为在线奖励，二是人类参考注入（HRI），即在每个GRPO组中，通过教师强制方式将人类撰写的故事作为高奖励锚点。通过将我们的训练方案应用于Qwen3.5-9B，使用从100部短篇小说选集中提取的约1.4K提示-故事对数据集以及4块A100 GPU，我们得到了POLARIS-9B。在涵盖分布内和分布外提示及评分标准的五个基准测试中，POLARIS-9B与前沿模型相比具有竞争力。
tldr: POLARIS通过LLM评判奖励与人类参考注入两项关键技术，仅用4块A100 GPU训练Qwen3.5-9B，使小型模型在长篇故事写作质量与长度控制上媲美前沿模型。
en_tdlr: POLARIS enables small models like Qwen3.5-9B to write long stories competitive with frontier models by combining LLM-as-a-judge rewards with human-reference injection, using only 4 A100 GPUs.
